question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option ‘no correction required’ if the sentence is correct as given.**

(**The big the house**), the more difficult it is to maintain it.
solution:
The correct answer is "The bigger the house."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the structure of the comparative construction.
 
• **"The bigger"** is the correct comparative form of **"big"** to compare the size of the house.
 
• **"The more difficult"** correctly indicates the increasing level of difficulty in maintaining the house as it gets bigger.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence: ***The bigger the house**__, the more difficult it is to maintain it.*
